title: batteryModel
description: The request body of EP-MODEL-CREATE: a battery model of the own company (section 10.2 of the implementation specification).

manufacturerPartId.description: The catalogue part identifier of the battery model of the own company.

catenaXId.description: The catenaXId of the PartType twin of the original battery model.

manufacturerBpnl.description: The Business Partner Number of the manufacturer of the original battery model.

originalModel.description: The original battery model of a treated battery (decision D35, The reference to the original battery model).
